coverage.text: User can enter a discount code in the cart
coverage.clarified_as: The cart page has a labelled 'Discount code' field and an Apply button.

coverage.text: Valid codes apply the discount to the total
coverage.clarified_as: SAVE10 = 10% off; FLAT20 = $20 off orders of $50+. Case-insensitive. One code at a time; a new code replaces the old. $120 cart: SAVE10 → $108.00, FLAT20 → $100.00. (Q-1, Q-6, Q-AI-2, Q-AI-3, Q-AI-4)
Unknown codes, expired codes (WELCOME5) and FLAT20 under $50 are refused with a message under the field; total unchanged. FLAT20 message states $50. (Q-2, Q-AI-1, Q-AI-3)

coverage.reason: No threshold agreed. PO recorded accepted risk (Q-3): 'Revisit after launch.' Without a number there is no pass/fail.

coverage.clarified_as: On a Pixel-size phone the shopper can enter a code, apply it and see the new total with no sideways scrolling. (Q-4, Q-5)
